title: Early small band with Johnny Deve and Henry Landry
summary: His first band was a six-piece group with Deve and Landry, lasting about a year.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I'm wondering about some of the other bands you played with then after, oh, who was the first band? The big arts that you played with, you mentioned that you stayed with them a while. If you want to go on and tell about a few of the other bands.
Well, there's so many of them that I played with. We had a little band we made up. You remember, you heard of Johnny Deve?
Yes, they played the banjo with Sam Morgan, I know.
Yeah, well, we had a little band we made up. And I played with them a pretty good while.
Henry Landry. He's away from here, I think he's in California. He put it down after, you know, after the band broke up.
Was he any relation to Big Landry, the big fella, the big guy, you know?
How many were in that band? Do you remember the other players, like the trombone or bass?
There was six pieces. There were six pieces in that band. That's about the only ones I remember. Johnny Deve and Landry on trumpet.
Yeah, they had trombone. I just can't remember who was playing the trombone. Or a bass player?
Had a banjo. Yeah. Didn't have any sax, no? No. No sax. How long were you with them?
Very long or just a short time? Oh, I was with them a pretty good while. And I'd say for about a year. Then you remember your next band about that you went with?
Well, in fact, they was the first band I played with. Oh, that was before Omar. Yeah.
